Asset: one fully HUMAN character skin, full-body transparent illustration for children's fantasy RPG.
Inputs1–4: PRIMARY STYLE references, original illustrations drawn by the user. Capture their shape construction and face/expression language, not just texture: slightly uneven warm red-brown pencil contours with pressure variation, soft rounded face, readable vertical oval eyes with modest highlights, simple tiny nose, cheek marks, distinctive brows and mouth, broad angular hair tufts, lively unpretentious children's storybook gesture. Broad flat pastel/colored-pencil color patches, subtle interior grain, short loose hatched shadows. Reinterpret the author's animal expressions/tufts as human eyes, posture and hair. Input5: existing character to REDRAW. Preserve identity, hair/eye colors, main outfit silhouette and colors, signature accessories, role and held equipment. It is ONLY a DESIGN reference, NOT a rendering reference: discard all pixel stair steps, glossy anime gacha gradients, metallic polish, dense micro-ornaments and perfect vector-like lines. Draw freshly from user's original hand rather than smoothing the target or merely adding pencil grain.
Medium: NON-PIXEL freehand digital pencil-and-pastel illustration, warm brown irregular outline, 3–4 broad shades per material, short confident hatching, warm expressive human face. Around 3-head cartoon proportions; distinguish this character's personality, not the same open-mouthed boy face on everyone. Detail hierarchy favors face and silhouette. A few LARGE readable ornaments retain identity without dense filigree. Practical modest full coverage appropriate to children's game.
Composition: square1:1, single full-body character, slight three-quarter front angle, whole hair/crown/feet/clothes/weapon/accessory inside canvas with at least 6–8% safe breathing margin. NO backdrop, paper rectangle, checkerboard painted into image, diffuse halo, vignette, ground shadow, floor, frame, text, labels, watermark, companions, extra characters, animal ears/tail/muzzle. No pixel art, visible square clusters, 3D, photorealism, dense jewel ornamentation or glossy lighting effects.
